lyrics:
[Intro: lone harmonica, fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1: raw cracked male voice, close and dry]
You left with the truck running, mad as July
Said this town was a jar with the lid screwed tight
I said some things too. I was tired. I was wrong.
I've been changing that bulb ever since you've been gone

[Chorus: voice lifts and strains, fiddle joins]
There's a porch light yellow at the end of this road
It don't ask where you've been, don't say I told you so
The moths all know it, and the dog does too
Porch light yellow, burning for you

[Verse 2: guitar and soft kick drum]
Your mama says give it time, says you're just like me
Stubborn as a fence post, quiet as a tree
I see your friends at the feed store, they don't know what to say
I buy bulbs by the dozen. I got plenty. I can wait.

[Chorus: fiddle and harmonica together]
There's a porch light yellow at the end of this road
It don't ask where you've been, don't say I told you so
The moths all know it, and the dog does too
Porch light yellow, burning for you

[Bridge: voice and harmonica only, almost spoken]
If the sun comes up and you ain't in the drive
I shut it off for the day, to save the light
And I turn it back on when the sky goes gray
That ain't hope. It's just what I do. Every day.

[Final Chorus: full band, voice breaking on the last line]
There's a porch light yellow at the end of this road
It don't ask where you've been, don't say I told you so
The moths all know it, and the dog does too
Porch light yellow
Come on home, kid. It's on for you.

[Outro: harmonica alone, a screen door, tires on gravel]
